introduction: Full-stack developer with a backend and data-centric focus. Building enterprise systems, search engines and financial logic — working with AI-assisted workflow since 2026.
role_subtitle: junior → medior · backend, data & search focused
neumann: BMSZC János Neumann Informatics Technical School
about_summary_1: Developer primarily working on the backend side of large, long-lifecycle enterprise systems: GraphQL-federated Node.js services and search engines. Contributing to multiple concurrent, live, nationally-scoped platforms — healthcare chamber membership registry, national library platform (ILS/OPAC), and a major public media CMS.
about_summary_2: I would realistically define my experience level as an emerging junior developer, elevated towards medior level by deep domain knowledge built over years. My strength lies in confident domain knowledge of business/financial and library systems, and in reliably delivering tasks within complex, live systems.
about_summary_3: Since early 2026, I exclusively work with AI-assisted development. I leverage AI coding tools built on strong backend and domain foundations, in a planned and supervised manner — review, quality control, and architectural decisions remain in human hands. This workflow enabled me to deliver production-quality work on new technology areas (Next.js/TypeScript, WordPress, accessibility).
comp_backend: GraphQL Federation (Apollo Gateway) based, modular Node.js backends; resolvers, business logic, REST & GraphQL API design
comp_search: Elasticsearch query DSL (nested bool/wildcard/terms), facet aggregations, relevance & linguistic sorting, accent normalization; MARC21/HUNMARC library data model; data migrations
comp_finance: Membership fee & category management, invoicing, fiscal year-end closing, balance & tax certificate generation, snapshot-based frozen state, transaction & concurrency handling
comp_background: Scheduled (cron) processes, message queue-based async processing (RabbitMQ), workflow engine (Camunda external task), external APIs (e.g. Billingo), email/notification systems
comp_fullstack: React-based interfaces (Material-UI), Next.js/TypeScript, WordPress theme & plugin development (PHP), desktop (Electron) client
comp_ai: AI coding workflow as primary daily method — efficient context & prompt management, generated code review, iteration and quality assurance
comp_workflow: Git/Bitbucket, pull-request-based collaboration, code review, JIRA-based ticketing, release-branch/sprint workflow
soft_ai: All daily development uses AI coding tools (Claude Code). The value lies in planned prompt & context management built on deep backend and domain knowledge, code review, and quality control.
soft_domain: Financial/membership management and library (MARC21/OPAC) domain expertise that spans across technologies.
soft_team: Multiple concurrent projects with large development teams, Bitbucket pull-request workflow, regular code review.
soft_reliability: Development of live systems handling financial and membership data, transaction-safe migrations and data corrections.
soft_delivery: JIRA feature/bugfix branches, release-branch and sprint workflow.
growth_1: System/platform architecture: moving towards independent architectural design.
growth_2: Deepening modern, typed backend stack (TypeScript-first: NestJS, tRPC) with hands-on practice.
growth_3: Building technological depth and independent coding routine.
